_comment: probe9b: the $40 one-layer 9B conversion probe (jobs/probe9b/JOB_SPEC.md). convert.pipeline with max_layers=1 and an ENFORCED gate: KL-importance ranking of the 8 attention layers after stage-1 alignment, the least important layer converted (stage-2 end-to-end KL), gate, probes on stock vs converted, throughput. micro_batch 4 (job-c4zkm OOM fix, measured on job-4j3vu at 31.9 GB). Stop (align.Guard): steady tok/s after 50 steps < 50% of the job-4j3vu MEASURED rate (stage 1 18,952 -> 9,476; stage 2 5,461 at the worst-case first layer -> 2,730) -> exit 3; peak > 76 GB -> exit 4.

success_rule._comment: Pre-registered success rule for proceeding from one converted layer to all 8 (scripts/decide_probe9b.py). Deltas are converted (1 layer GDN, 7 attention) minus stock, same code path, same items.

verdicts.proceed-all-8: gate passed and every quality, retrieval and Index criterion passed -> open the ~$150 full-conversion spend issue (all 8 layers, KL order, accept/rollback, recall levers)
verdicts.retrieval-fail: gate, quality and Index passed but MQAR or S-NIAH fell past its bound -> pre-registered fallback: no full-8 spend; report the cost-of-attention-freedom curve; RWKV7 jobs; ship-hybrid is decision-needed for the user
verdicts.quality-fail: gate rejected the layer, or ppl / MMLU / Index fell past its bound -> no full-8 spend; RWKV7 jobs (jobs/rwkv7)

bands._comment: POST-HOC DIAGNOSTIC, NOT USED FOR THE VERDICT. Written after seeing the job-4j3vu qualification 9B layer-3 gate numbers (dNLL -0.0005, KL 0.054, cos 0.980); reported in decision.json under diagnostic_bands_posthoc only. The binding verdict is success_rule (pre-registered at commit 511e8dd, unchanged). Derivation: dNLL green = 0.15/8 = 0.019; KL and (1 - cos) green = 3x the 0.8B pilot (KL 0.017, cos 0.991, the cos value coordinator-reported and unverified); amber edges = the enforced gate or ~3x green.

adjust_hint._comment: POST-HOC DIAGNOSTIC SUGGESTION ONLY: never changes the verdict and never authorises spend. Uses the measured stage-2 KL gain = (importance KL of the layer after stage 1 - gate KL after stage 2) / the former.
adjust_hint.if_stage2_not_learning: stage-2 gained < 10% of its starting KL: stage 2 is not the lever (job-4j3vu layer 3 moved 0.051 -> 0.054 in 35 min): re-probe with stage-1 1,200 steps and stage-2 lr 1e-4
adjust_hint.if_stage2_learning: stage-2 gained >= 10%: the cap stopped a still-improving run: re-probe with stage-2 max_minutes 120 (same lr)
